description:
`piSST-pxK` is part of a set of AGCM timeslice experiments (also including `a4SSTice` and `a4SSTice-4xCO2`) designed to examine regional climate responses to CO2 forcing. `piSST-pxK` minus `piControl` provides the response to a uniform SST increase. The CMIP5/CMIP6 versions of these experiments are described in [Chadwick et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00382-016-3488-6) and [Webb et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-10-359-2017) but note that there have been significant changes made to the experimental protocol for CMIP7 [Ceppi et al. (2026)](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-19-8693-2026).

`piSST-pxK` is an AGCM experiment using monthly time-varying sea-ice and atmospheric constituents from 30 years of each model's own `piControl` run. The 30 years should be chosen to be parallel to years 111-140 of the `abrupt-4xCO2` run. SSTs are also taken from `piControl` in the same way as sea-ice, but are uniformly increased by x K in ice-free regions, where x is the global, climatological annual-mean ice-free SST change between years 111-140 of abrupt-4xCO2 and the parallel section of piControl. Note that x should be both spatially and temporally constant. In `piSST-pxK`, sea ice and SSTs in grid boxes containing sea ice should remain the same as in `piControl`. To set up the experiment, it is recommended to start from a `piClim-control` configuration, then alter the SST and sea-ice boundary conditions (including making them time-varying rather than climatological).
